_about: The My Notes file format as the models read it (core/note_format.py contract()): the Reformat prompt, Wiskit Deep's note tools, the Claude Code mode and the local MCP tools. projects/note-organic-ui/plans/01-note-format-agents.md. Keep it in step with core/note_format.py and web/src/lib/note-format.ts.
contract: Brainamon note format (My Notes). A note body is Markdown: # Title, ## Heading, ### Subheading, plain paragraphs, - bullets, 1. numbered items, - [ ] open task and - [x] done task, > quote, --- on its own line for a dotted divider, **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, `code`, and [id N] to cite a library item. ==words== is the yellow highlighter. Exactly three HTML tags are allowed, written exactly like this: underlined words, highlighted words (markers: sun, mint, peach, sky) and coloured words (inks: graphite, indigo, sky, leaf, sun, ember, rose). Any other tag or attribute shows as plain text. Tags may nest; close every tag you open. Keep every existing highlight, ink, underline and task tick unless you are asked to change it. Stamps are small drawings placed on the page next to the text. They live in the note's frontmatter as one line of JSON: stamps: [{"k":"kettlebell","at":"The sequence","x":-4,"y":1,"s":3,"c":"indigo","r":0}]. k is the drawing (flower, sun, star, heart, check, arrow, sprout, mushroom, cloud, bolt, coffee, bulb, kettlebell, pin, note, question, snail, sparkle, flag, smile); at is the exact text of the heading the stamp sits next to, or top (beside the title) or end (below the last line); x is the column in 24 px cells (negative counts from the right edge of the page, so -4 sits in the right margin; 0 or more counts from the left edge of the text); y is how many text rows below that heading; s is the size, 2, 3 or 4 cells; c is one of the inks; r is the tilt, -8, 0 or 8. When you rename a heading, update the at of its stamps.
